title: 印尼财长三个目标：增长经济 保护民众，预算还要可信，如何做到？
speaker: Suwa Hasil Nizarra

segments.en: audience, the budget that grows the economy, the budget that protects the people,
segments.zh: 观众，预算要增长经济，预算要保护民众，

segments.en: and the budget that is credible for our sustainability. In order to do that,
segments.zh: 预算要对我们的可持续性保持可信。为了做到这一点，

segments.en: because there is an intention, in order to do that, I will work very close
segments.zh: 因为有意愿，为了做到这一点，我将非常紧密地

segments.en: with every institution in Indonesia. The two arms, obviously, by nature, we are working together
segments.zh: 与印尼的每一个机构合作。这两条臂膀，本质上我们正在共同协作，

segments.en: with our financial sector stability forum. That is also very important.
segments.zh: 与我们的金融部门稳定论坛合作。这也非常重要。

segments.en: And then we are managing Indonesia, of course, not only from the central government,
segments.zh: 然后我们管理印尼，当然不仅仅是从中央政府层面，

segments.en: but also talking to a lot of local governments.
segments.zh: 还要与许多地方政府沟通。

segments.en: And investors can expect policy continuity from your predecessor?
segments.zh: 市场参与者可以期待你延续前任的政策吗？

segments.en: From time to time, we always reconsider our position and that reconsideration might end up in
segments.zh: 我们会不时重新审视我们的立场，这种重新审视可能会形成

segments.en: the new policy, but Indonesia has already shown in the 20 years how fiscal credibility and
segments.zh: 新的政策，但印尼在过去20年已经展示了财政可信度和

segments.en: how fiscal sustainability has been maintained. Our Indonesian business sector, global communities
segments.zh: 财政可持续性是如何维持的。我们的印尼商界、全球各界

segments.en: can expect that we will continue with that kind of credibility.
segments.zh: 可以期待我们将继续保持这种可信度。
